desc: This light weight, tactical style .22lr caliber rifle is every plinking master's dream come true! Based off of the classic GSG 22 caliber rifle operating system, the GSG-16 features several enhancments to give it a dashing new look for the next generation of shooters. The GSG-16 features a newly designed collapsable stock that also serves as an additional magazine storage compartment for either high or low capacity magazines. The re-designed forend features standard picatinny rails mounted onto an MLOK style hand guard.
